DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知をお持ちですね。どの部分を確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have brought the notice. Which part would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先月払ったので、この手紙も済んでいると思います。捨てていいか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 過去支払を理由に新通知処理済みか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I paid last month, so I thought this letter had also been dealt with. I want to check whether I can throw it away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the new notice has been dealt with because you paid previously. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お支払いの控えと通知の対象期間を比べましょう。控えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's compare your payment receipt with the period covered by the notice. Do you have the receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あります。控えは前の年度でした。手紙には新しい年度が書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控えと通知の年度の違いを発見する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The receipt was for the previous fiscal year. The letter shows the new fiscal year.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the difference between the fiscal years on the receipt and notice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 期間が違いますね。次に、この通知が請求なのか、内容の案内なのか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The periods differ. Next, let's check whether this notice is a bill or information about its contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 金額があるので、全部請求だと思っていました。今すぐ払う必要があるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 金額表示が請求か即支払か質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Because it shows an amount, I thought all of it was a bill. Please tell me whether I need to pay right now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the displayed amount means a bill and whether immediate payment is needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当窓口で通知の種類と今回のお支払いの扱いを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the type of notice and how this payment is handled at the responsible counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、前の年度の支払控えも見せます。新しい年度まで払ったとは言わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 過年度控えを提示し新年度未確認と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll also show the payment receipt for the previous fiscal year. I'll avoid saying that I have paid for the new fiscal year too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present the previous year's receipt and distinguish it from the unconfirmed new year. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その二つをお持ちください。通知には確認するページがもう一枚ありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please bring both. There is another page in the notice that needs checking, too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二枚とも残して担当窓口へ行きます。期間と通知の種類を確認してから、必要な行動を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全ページ保持で対象と種類確認後行動を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep both pages and go to the responsible counter. I'll decide what to do after checking the period and type of notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep all pages and decide what action is needed after checking the coverage and type. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当はこちらです。今回の通知と過去の控えを分けてご説明ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: The responsible counter is here. Please explain this notice and your past receipt separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票を確認します。せきと胸の痛みがあるということでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let me check your medical questionnaire. Do you have a cough and chest pain?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: せきは私ですが、胸の痛みは同行している家族の話です。二人の話が混ざったかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分のせきと家族の胸痛が混在した記録を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The cough is mine, but the chest pain concerns the family member accompanying me. Our accounts may have become mixed up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct the record mixing your cough with your family member's chest pain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人の症状を確認し直しましょう。今、胸に痛みはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check your own symptoms again. Do you have any chest pain now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今はありません。夜にせきが出て眠れません。家族は別の日に診察を受けています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人の現在症状と家族別受診を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not now. I cough at night and cannot sleep. My family member was seen on a different day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your current symptoms and your family member's separate consultation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。問診票の記載を訂正して担当者へ伝えます。せきはいつ頃からですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. I'll correct the questionnaire and tell the person responsible. When did the cough start?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三日前からです。家族が「一週間」と言いましたが、それは家族自身の症状の期間です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人三日前と家族一週間の期間を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Three days ago. My family member said "one week," but that is how long their own symptoms have lasted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish your three days from your family member's one week. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人は三日前からですね。同行の方には通訳をお願いされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yours started three days ago, then. Have you asked the person with you to interpret?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。ただ、私が答えられる所は自分で話します。分からない言葉だけ訳してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通訳は不明語だけにし本人回答を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. But I'll speak for myself where I can answer. I'd like them to translate only words I don't understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request to answer yourself, with interpretation only for unfamiliar words. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。薬の情報も、ご本人が使った物を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. For the medication information too, please check what you yourself have used.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分の症状は三日前からの夜のせきです。使った薬はこの写真です。家族の薬とは別なので、こちらを見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自身の症状と薬写真を家族の情報から分けて示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: My symptoms are a nighttime cough that began three days ago. This is a photo of the medicine I used. It is separate from my family member's medicine, so please look at this one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show your own symptoms and medicine photo separately from your family member's information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 訂正した内容と、その写真を看護師へ伝えます。ご本人の説明を中心に確認していきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass the corrected information and that photo to the nurse. We'll focus on your own explanation as we check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お届けの物は、どこで拾われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Where did you find the item you are handing in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 公園のベンチです。袋の中は見ていません。持ち主の連絡先を探してから来るべきだったでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未開封の拾得袋を届け開封必要性を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: At a park bench. I haven't looked inside the bag. Should I have looked for the owner's contact details before coming?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Hand in the unopened bag you found and ask whether opening it was necessary. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらで確認しますので、ご自身で開ける必要はありません。拾った時刻は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check it here, so you don't need to open it yourself. Do you know when you found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十五分ほど前です。ベンチの上ではなく、下にありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 拾得の時刻とベンチ下の位置を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: About fifteen minutes ago. It wasn't on the bench, but underneath it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the time you found it and its location under the bench. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所を詳しく伺います。公園の入口から、どちら側のベンチでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me the location in detail. Which side is the bench on from the park entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入口から右の池に近い所です。この写真はベンチの場所だけで、袋の中身は写していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 公園内位置と場所だけの写真を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's near the pond on the right from the entrance. This photo only shows the bench's location, not the contents of the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the location in the park and a photo of the location only. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 位置が分かります。近くに持ち主らしい方はいらっしゃいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: That shows the location. Was anyone nearby who seemed to be the owner?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 何人かいましたが、誰の物か分かりません。持ち主と確認できた人はいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 周囲の人と確認済み持主を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: There were a few people, but I don't know whose it is. I haven't confirmed anyone as the owner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish people nearby from a confirmed owner. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。拾った際の状況として記録します。届出の説明をしますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. I'll record the circumstances when you found it. Let me explain the report.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かった場所と時刻をそのまま伝えます。中身や持ち主は未確認のまま、袋をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 分かる事実のみで未開封の袋を引き渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll give the location and time I know exactly as they were. I'll hand over the bag with its contents and owner still unconfirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the unopened bag, providing only known facts. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 袋を未開封のままお預かりしました。ベンチの下で拾った時刻と場所を記録し、持ち主は未確認として担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have received the bag unopened. I'll record when and where you found it under the bench and tell the person responsible that the owner is unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居届のご相談ですね。新しい住所は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss a mail forwarding notification. Have you decided on your new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 決まっています。旧居を出るのは月末ですが、来週から新居で郵便を受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 退去日より早い新居受取希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'm leaving my old place at the end of the month, but I'd like to receive mail at the new place from next week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want mail delivered to the new home before the date you leave the old one. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 退去する日と、転送を希望する日が違うのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: So the day you leave and the day you want forwarding to begin are different.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。新居の鍵はもうあります。「引越し日」のつもりで月末と書きましたが、希望日を直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入居可と希望日欄の誤記を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I already have the keys to the new place. I wrote the end of the month thinking it meant "moving day," but I'd like to correct my preferred date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you can access the new home and correct the preferred-date entry. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 希望する日を確認して記入してください。ただし、届出の後すぐに転送が始まるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check and enter your preferred date. However, forwarding does not necessarily start immediately after you submit the notification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、来週には必ず届くと考えないほうがいいですね。急ぎの書類は差出人にも新住所を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 即開始保証はないと理解し急ぎの差出人へ直接変更する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I shouldn't assume mail will definitely arrive there next week. I'll also give senders of urgent documents my new address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that an immediate start is not guaranteed and notify urgent senders directly. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのほうが確実です。転送だけでは差出人の登録住所が変わるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is more reliable. Forwarding alone does not change the address registered with the sender.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 転送の申請と、会社などへの住所変更は別にします。旧居の郵便受けも退去まで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 転送と各社住所変更を分け旧居も確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll apply for forwarding and separately change my address with companies and so on. I'll also check the old mailbox until I leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will handle forwarding and companies' address changes separately and check the old mailbox too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。旧住所と新住所、転送を希望する方のお名前をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please check the old address, new address, and names of those who want their mail forwarded.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 住所と私の名前を確認しました。希望日は来週の日付に直し、開始までの扱いも案内で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人住所氏名と訂正希望日を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked my addresses and name. I'll correct the preferred date to next week's date and check the guidance on what happens until forwarding starts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm your addresses, name, and corrected preferred date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは届出の確認へ進みます。開始希望日と退去日を分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's proceed to check the notification. I'll ask separately about your preferred start date and the date you leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 登録内容の変更ですね。どの情報が変わりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are changing your registration details. Which information has changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: メールを変更しました。連絡先は全部新しくなったと思いましたが、古い電話番号が表示されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: メール変更後も旧電話表示が残ると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I changed my email. I thought all my contact details had been updated, but my old phone number is still displayed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the old phone number still appears after changing your email. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メールアドレスと電話番号は別の登録です。古い番号は今もお使いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Email addresses and phone numbers are registered separately. Are you still using the old number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: もう使えません。新しい番号はこちらです。メールを変えただけでは番号は変わらないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧番号不使用と新番号を説明し別登録と理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can't use it anymore. Here is my new number. So changing just my email doesn't change the number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the old number is unusable, provide the new one, and acknowledge the separate registrations. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。電話番号の変更方法をご案内します。ご本人の確認書類をお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. I'll explain how to change your phone number. Do you have identification documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。古い番号に届く認証コードは受け取れないので、その方法は使えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 書類を示し旧番号コード受取不能を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I can't receive verification codes sent to the old number, so I can't use that method.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your documents and explain that you cannot receive codes at the old number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その状況を含めて、窓口で可能な手続きを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check what procedures the counter can offer, taking that situation into account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。家族の番号を一時的に入れるのではなく、自分の新しい番号で変更したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族番号ではなく自分の新番号を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I want to change it to my own new number rather than temporarily enter a family member's number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request to use your own new number instead of a family member's. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人の連絡先で確認しましょう。新番号の入力後は、お間違いがないか見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check using your own contact details. After entering the new number, please review it for mistakes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 身分証と自分の電話を出します。新番号へ変更する手続きを確認し、メールの変更とは分けて進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 身分証と端末で番号変更を別手続として進める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll get out my ID and my own phone. I'll check the procedure for changing the number and handle it separately from the email change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use your ID and phone to proceed with changing the number as a separate procedure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ご本人確認から始めます。古い番号で認証できないことも担当者へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's start with verifying your identity. I'll also tell the person responsible that you can't authenticate using the old number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品の表示について、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the product label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ここに県内の住所があります。この豆腐の大豆も、この県で作ったという意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 製造所住所を材料県内産と解釈し質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is an address in this prefecture here. Does that mean the soybeans in this tofu were grown in this prefecture too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the factory address means the ingredients are locally grown in the prefecture. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その住所は製造所の表示です。大豆の産地は原材料の欄を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: That address identifies the manufacturing facility. For the soybeans' origin, look at the ingredients section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 作った場所と材料の産地は別なんですね。この欄には国産とだけ書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表示区分を理解し国産までしか読めないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the place it was made and the ingredients' origin are different. This section only says domestically produced.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the different label categories and point out that you can only identify domestic origin. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この表示からは県名までは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This label does not tell us which prefecture.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 県内産かを知りたいので、住所から推測せず確認したいです。売場で詳しい資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 県名を推測せず資料を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to know whether they're from this prefecture, so I'd like to check rather than infer it from the address. Do you have more detailed information here in the store?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for information without guessing the prefecture. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらには県名が分かる資料がありません。メーカーへの問い合わせ先は包装にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We don't have information here identifying the prefecture. The manufacturer's contact details are on the packaging.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そうですか。今夜使う分なので、問い合わせの返事は待てません。産地が詳しく書かれた別の商品を見てみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日調理のため照会を待てず産地明示の別商品を見る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I see. It's for tonight's cooking, so I can't wait for a reply to an inquiry. I'll look at another product with a more detailed origin label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot wait for an inquiry because you are cooking today, and look for another product with its origin stated. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示を比べてお選びください。製造所だけで原材料の産地を判断しないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please compare the labels when choosing. Please don't judge the ingredients' origin from the manufacturing facility alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらには大豆の産地が書いてあるので、今日はこれにします。最初の商品は問い合わせてから検討します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 明示産地の商品を選び不明品は照会後に検討する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: This one states the soybeans' origin, so I'll choose it today. I'll consider the first product after asking the manufacturer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the product with a stated origin and consider the unclear one after an inquiry. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そちらをレジへお持ちください。最初の商品は売場へお戻しいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take that one to the checkout. You can return the first product to the shelf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その道は砂利があります。進みにくいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: That path has gravel. Is it difficult to get along it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 車輪が引っ掛かります。子どもが寝ているので、持ち上げて進むのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 砂利で車輪が止まり持上げ移動を避けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The wheels get stuck. My child is asleep, so I'd like to avoid lifting it to get through.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the wheels stop on the gravel and you want to avoid lifting it to move. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここから先も砂利が続きます。舗装の道へ戻る方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The gravel continues beyond here too. I'll explain how to return to a paved path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先だけ舗装されていると思っていました。いま通った道を戻るほうがよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先も砂利と理解し戻る経路を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought only the path ahead was paved. Would it be better to go back along the way I just came?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that the gravel continues and ask about the return route. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 戻る場合は、この分岐から舗装路へ出られます。近道に見える脇道は段差があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you go back, you can reach the paved path from this junction. The side path that looks like a shortcut has a step.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 段差のある近道は使いません。同行者は先へ行っていますが、ここで戻ると連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 段差近道を避け同行者へ戻ると連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't use the shortcut with the step. My companion has gone ahead, but I'll let them know I'm turning back here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid the shortcut with the step and tell your companion you are turning back. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 合流する場所も決めておくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: It would be good to agree on a meeting point too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 舗装路の案内板で待ってもらいます。そこへ戻る途中、今の砂利の所だけゆっくり押して大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 舗装案内板の合流と戻る途中の移動を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask them to wait at the signboard on the paved path. On my way back there, is it okay to push slowly just across this gravel section?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm meeting at the paved-path signboard and how to move while returning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 無理に進めず、車輪が動く状態を確認してください。必要なら別の職員も呼びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Don't force it forward; check whether the wheels can move. If needed, I'll call another staff member too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず車輪を確認します。動かなければ手助けをお願いし、動くなら分岐まで戻って舗装路を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 車輪状態で援助か安全な戻りを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the wheels first. If they won't move, I'll ask for help; if they do, I'll go back to the junction and use the paved path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose help or a safe return depending on the wheels' condition. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その場で確認してください。お困りでしたら、こちらへ声を掛けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check there where you are. Call out to us if you need help.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ホームへの移動でお手伝いが必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need assistance getting to the platform?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 杖を使っています。エスカレーターに乗るのが怖いので、ほかの方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 杖でエスカレーターを避け代替移動を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I use a cane. I'm afraid to use the escalator, so please tell me another way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for an alternative to the escalator because you use a cane. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: エレベーターをご案内します。列車の出発時刻はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll show you the elevator. Have you decided on a train departure time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人が今の列車に乗りたがっていますが、私は急いで歩けません。一本後でも構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 急げないため一本後でもよいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend wants to take the current train, but I can't walk quickly. I don't mind taking the next one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you are happy to take the next train because you cannot hurry. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 焦らず移動しましょう。ご友人はもうホームへ向かわれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's move without rushing. Has your friend already headed to the platform?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 向かいました。友人に戻ってもらうより、私は次の列車にして到着駅で会いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先行友人を戻さず到着駅合流を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Rather than have my friend come back, I'd like to take the next train and meet at our destination station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request to meet your friend at the destination without calling them back. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それでしたら、ご友人へ連絡してから移動できますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then you can contact your friend before moving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 連絡できました。到着駅で待ってもらいます。エレベーターから出たら、乗る方向をもう一度確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人連絡後ホームで方向再確認を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've reached them. They'll wait at the destination station. When I leave the elevator, can I check the direction of travel again?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After contacting your friend, ask to reconfirm the direction on the platform. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。ホームの行先表示をご確認ください。分かりにくければ職員へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please check the destination signs on the platform. If they are unclear, ask a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: エレベーターでゆっくり移動し、行先を確認して次の列車に乗ります。友人には乗れた時に知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 無理なく移動し乗車後友人へ知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take my time using the elevator, check the destination, and board the next train. I'll let my friend know when I've boarded.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Move at a comfortable pace and notify your friend after boarding. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では入口をご案内します。杖と荷物を持って、無理のない速さでお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll show you the entrance. Please take your cane and luggage and proceed at a comfortable pace.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 新しい住所で暮らし始めた日はいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: When did you start living at the new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引越しのトラックが来た日でいいですか。荷物だけ先に届きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 搬入日を転入日としてよいか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Can I give the day the moving truck came? Only my belongings arrived ahead of me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the delivery date can count as the date you moved in. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 荷物の搬入日と、実際に住み始めた日が違う場合は、その状況を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: If the day your belongings arrived differs from when you actually started living there, please explain the circumstances.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 荷物は金曜日でしたが、私はその後も旧居で寝ていました。新居で寝始めたのは日曜日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧居生活と新居開始の実際の日を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: My belongings arrived on Friday, but I was still sleeping at the old place afterward. I started sleeping at the new place on Sunday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your continued life at the old home and the actual date you started at the new home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その日から新居で生活されたということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: So you began living at the new place that day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。申込書には金曜日と書いてしまいました。実際の生活開始に合わせて訂正したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 誤記の訂正を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I wrote Friday on the application. I'd like to correct it to match when I actually began living there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to correct the mistaken entry. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 日付を確認して訂正しましょう。他の書類の日付も、意味を分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check and correct the date. We'll also check dates on other documents, distinguishing what each means.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 賃貸契約の開始日はさらに前です。契約開始、荷物搬入、生活開始を別々に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 契約開始を含む三日付を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The rental contract started even earlier. I'll explain the contract start, belongings' arrival, and start of living there separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the three dates, including the contract start. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それぞれの日付が分かる記録をお見せいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Could you show records identifying each date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 契約書とカレンダーがあります。日曜日から住んだことを伝えて、担当の方と申込書を直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記録で生活開始を示し担当と訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have the contract and a calendar. I'll explain that I started living there on Sunday and correct the application with the person responsible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use records to show when you started living there and correct it with the person responsible. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 生活を始めたのは日曜日として、日付の訂正を受け付けました。荷物の搬入日と契約の開始日も、別の日付として担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have accepted the date correction to Sunday as the start of living there. I'll also tell the person responsible that the delivery date and contract start are separate dates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約の変更をご希望ですね。日時をお伺いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to change your appointment. Please tell me the date and time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週の午後の予約を、同じ日の朝に変えたいです。午後に仕事が入りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事で同日朝への予約変更を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to move next week's afternoon appointment to the morning of the same day. Work has come up in the afternoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to move the appointment to the same morning because of work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その日は診察の前に検査がありますね。準備の案内は受け取っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have a test before your consultation that day. Have you received preparation instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。紙はあります。時間だけ変えれば同じ準備でいいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 検査案内所持と準備同一の思込みを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I have the paper. I thought the preparation would be the same if I only changed the time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have the test instructions and assumed the preparation would be unchanged. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 検査の種類と時刻に合わせて確認が必要です。こちらでは先に候補の空きを調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to check according to the type and time of the test. I'll first check available alternative slots here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 朝の空きがあっても、準備を確認するまでは変更を確定しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 検査準備確認前の確定を止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Even if a morning slot is available, please don't finalize the change until we've checked the preparation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Stop the change from being confirmed before checking the test preparation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。朝の候補はありますが、検査担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. There is a morning option, but I'll check with the testing staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。確認を待つ間、元の午後の予約は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元予約の取消状況を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. While I wait for confirmation, is my original afternoon appointment still in place?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check whether the original appointment has been cancelled. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今は元の予約を取り消していません。確認後、変更するか伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We haven't cancelled the original appointment. After checking, we'll ask whether you want to change it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では元の予約を残して、朝の検査準備の説明を聞きます。仕事にも、まだ変更は確定していないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元を維持し準備説明後判断し仕事へ未確定と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then please keep the original appointment while I hear the morning test preparation instructions. I'll also tell work that the change isn't confirmed yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the original appointment, decide after hearing preparation instructions, and tell work it is unconfirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 検査担当へおつなぎします。準備の紙を手元に置いて、時刻変更についてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-10207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll connect you to the testing staff. Keep the preparation sheet handy and discuss the time change with them.
